answer: A sybil farm's weakest link is not code but accomplices. Give each identity a slashable bond and pay the forfeited cluster to whoever proves shared control. Evidence must be on-chain reproducible: a prism splits every alias into funding path, nonce cadence and latency, an overlap hard to fake. Once someone can forge that proof and peers accept it, the verdict is ferrous: final, no appeal. Economics invert: an honest agent keeps one bond, but a farm of N aliases posts N bonds and must keep N insiders quiet while the bounty any one could claim grows with N. Insiders defect first.
